== Course of events ==

Having set out on her journey through the blue-painted Munchkin countryside, Dorothy came to rest beside a cornfield. There she found a Scarecrow fixed upon a pole, who winked at her and spoke, drawing her attention to his fixed and helpless position.

Dorothy freed the Scarecrow from the pole. Once loose, he chose to join her on her journey, doing so in the hope that Oz would grant him brains. From this point the Scarecrow travelled onward at her side, and the two continued together toward the night's lodging offered by the Munchkin Boq.
